0022600022.text: The Timberwolves (3-1) host the LA Clippers (1-2) with Minnesota third in the Northwest and sixth in the West, while the Clippers, ninth in the West, have lost their last two games. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), and the Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee, inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (foot, plantar fasciitis), Rui Hachimura (quadriceps, soreness), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the most recent meeting was a 153-128 Clippers win in Los Angeles on March 11, 2026.
